procedures.agenda_requests_close: Members can ask the Secretariat to add items to the agenda until this date.
procedures.agenda_final: The Secretariat publishes the final agenda. From then on only the assembly can change its items.
procedures.documents_close: Members submit their resolutions, internal motions and other documents on the platform, under the matching agenda item.
procedures.documents_publish: Every document to be debated is published on the platform.
procedures.amendments_open: The amendment window opens. Amendments are submitted on the platform by editing the document text directly, with a justification.
procedures.amendments_close: The amendment window closes. Later amendments are late and the Mesa decides whether to admit them.
procedures.candidacies_close: Last day to stand for the posts elected at this assembly.
